$schema_note: Known virtual camera fingerprints used by audit-virtualcam.sh on Linux. driver_names are matched against v4l2-ctl -D output (V1); name_patterns against card labels (V1); module_names against lsmod (V4-equivalent residual check); sysfs patterns against /sys/class/video4linux/*/device/uevent paths (V4-equivalent).

driver_names.product: real UVC driver identity (also what the forked module reports)

module_names.product: stock v4l2loopback (identity reverts to the stock tell)
this fork (documented residual: the module itself is visible)
